focus: Is your product locked with real evidence someone will buy it? Do you have a genuine backup supplier, not just a primary?
Is your pitch deck IC-ready? Does it show a real path to ₹7L, not just a good story?
Is your store actually live and taking payments? Is your 4-week content calendar submitted?
Which channels actually got you to ₹75K? Who are your first 10 customers, by name?
Which channel is genuinely profitable? What does your cost tracker say about margin?
Is your reflection honest about what's not working, not just a highlight reel?
Has your influencer collaboration actually gone live? What's genuinely automated now, not just planned?
Is your team fully flea ready: inventory, payments, plan? Is your capital repayment on track?
